title: Pacaccini shot at and disappears for 20 years
summary: James Fox tells of Pacaccini shot at and disappears for 20 years, about after 1996 at Brazil, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: come forward and said yet. Pacchini apparently was shot at.

plain: James Fox, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels' show about a 1996 case in Brazil where the army is said to have captured a live alien, talked about a man named Vitorio Pacaccini who had looked into it. Fox says Pacaccini was apparently shot at and then vanished from view for about twenty years. If true, it would suggest someone wanted the story kept quiet.
